mapper.update: UPDATE t_http_audit_queue SET task_status='PROCESSING',lease_holder=#{holder}, lease_expires_at=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 1 MINUTE),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM t_http_audit_queue WHERE task_status IN ('PENDING','RETRY_PENDING','PROCESSING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at<=NOW(3)) AND (task_status<>'PROCESSING' OR lease_expires_at<NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) candidate)
mapper.select: SELECT id,actor_id,operation, audit_class,outcome,target_type,target_id,request_id,client_ip,event_detail,retry_count FROM t_http_audit_queue WHERE lease_holder=#{holder} AND task_status='PROCESSING'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_http_audit_queue SET task_status='COMPLETED',completed_at=NOW(3),lease_holder=NULL, lease_expires_at=NULL,error_detail=NULL WHERE id=#{id}
